patch_description: The current program (parameter-efficient CNOT/CRZ chain) underperforms the earlier "diagonal RY + shared ZZ ring" seed which scored 0.41, the best result so far. I revert the ANSATZ_SPEC to that higher-scoring structure (shared-parameter RY layers, ZZ ring, shared RZ, long-range ZZ, closing RY) and additionally prepend a disjoint XX-Ising entangling block on qubit pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7) sharing a single new parameter "xx_a". This early amplitude-mixing entanglement (X-basis coupling) complements the existing Z-basis (ZZ) entanglement and RY/RZ rotations, giving the circuit access to a richer set of correlations at the cost of only one extra distinct parameter (7 total vs 6), which should help worst-group margin/robust separation while keeping parameter count low, consistent with the requirement that parameter economy and robustness both matter.
